title: Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers Extra Dungeon
native_title: デビル・サマナー ソウル・ハッカーズ ＥＸＴＲＡ ダンジョン
overview:
Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers Extra Dungeon is a not-for-sale bonus disc that adds an extra dungeon to Devil Summoner: Soul Hackers, the first-person demon-summoning role-playing game from Atlus.

The disc does not stand alone: it loads your save data from Soul Hackers and lets you take that party into a new dungeon to explore and fight through.

- Requires a Soul Hackers save in which the COMP has already been obtained
- Saves from the Vision Quest sections cannot be used
- Saving and suspending are not possible while playing the extra dungeon
